title: VRF-Lite and MP-BGP: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: One router can serve many customers. Each one wants their own private routing table. A V R F gives them exactly that.

scenes.heading: The apartment mailroom
scenes.narration: Picture one mailroom with separate shelves for each tenant. Each V R F is its own private routing table. V R F lite works on one router, and needs no M P L S. M P B G P carries V P N routes between routers. A route distinguisher makes each route unique.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. V R F lite doesn't use M P L S. M P B G P carries many address families. The route target controls import, not the R D.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva VRF and MP-BGP lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. A V R F is a private routing table. M P B G P carries V P N routes. The R D only makes routes unique. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva VRF and MP-BGP lab.
